svg.title: Çılgın Kurye LED board: strip layout 0.1.0 (1:1, mm)
svg.text: Strip layout 0.1.0 from city plan 0.2.0: 308 LEDs (5.1 m), 5 per segment, road pitch 112 mm, gap at crossings 28.7 mm.
Chain A: east-west roads and stores (158 LEDs). Chain B: north-south roads (150 LEDs). Arrow = data direction, dashed = jumper wire, A12 = first LED index.
View from above. North is up. Sensor and motors sit under the base.
